brief: A tool rack that hangs on a wall from keyhole hangers, with hooks for small hand tools.

requirements.requirement: Tool rack hangs on wall from keyhole hangers
requirements.evidence: 3x hex-acc-keyhole on rear face slot 4: accessory:0#-1,0#4, accessory:0#0,0#4, accessory:0#1,0#4 - lift-and-drop mounting on wall screws across full 3-cell width
3x hex-acc-hook on front face slot 1: accessory:0#-1,0#1, accessory:0#0,0#1, accessory:0#1,0#1 - each plate carries two hooks side-by-side (6 hooks total) for pliers, wrenches, etc.

finish.summary: 3-cell linear hexagonal tool rack (-1,0,0 / 0,0,0 / 1,0,0 full pieces joined by 2 jointBolts). Rear (slot 4) has 3 keyhole hangers for wall mounting; front (slot 1) has 3 hook plates (6 hooks). check_build: ok true, meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
Build is a 3-cell linear tool rack (pieces at -1,0,0 / 0,0,0 / 1,0,0 joined with 2 jointBolts) with wall-mount on the rear and tool hooks on the front. Verified with `check_build`: ok, meshClash clear.

**Keyhole mounting:** 3× `hex-acc-keyhole` on rear face (slot 4) - `accessory:0#-1,0#4`, `accessory:0#0,0#4`, `accessory:0#1,0#4` - provides lift-and-drop wall hanging across full width.

**Tool hooks:** 3× `hex-acc-hook` on front face (slot 1) - `accessory:0#-1,0#1`, `accessory:0#0,0#1`, `accessory:0#1,0#1` - each plate carries two hooks side-by-side (6 hooks total) for small hand tools like pliers, wrenches, etc. Uses exposed front faces; seam faces correctly rejected.

Remaining info note `OPEN_CAP_FACE` is optional trim only.
